title: Rain in the City
text:
It is raining in the city today. The streets are wet and the sky is grey. Many people carry umbrellas. Ali is at home and he reads a book.

Tomorrow the weather will be better. The sun will come out in the morning. It will be warm and windy in the afternoon. Ali wants to go to the beach.

questions.text: What is the sky like today?
When will the sun come out?
Why are many people carrying umbrellas?
Where does Ali probably want to go tomorrow?

vocabulary.definition: covered with water or another liquid
with a lot of moving air
objects you hold over your head to stay dry in the rain
not cold, with a pleasant temperature

paragraph_translations: Bugün şehirde yağmur yağıyor. Sokaklar ıslak ve gökyüzü gri. Birçok insan şemsiye taşıyor. Ali evde ve bir kitap okuyor.
Yarın hava daha iyi olacak. Sabah güneş çıkacak. Öğleden sonra hava ılık ve rüzgarlı olacak. Ali plaja gitmek istiyor.
